skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Separate Whole/Fraction Extraction
skills.definition: Managing mixed numbers or whole numbers by separating and calculating their integer and fractional parts independently.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing from the whole number part when the fractional subtraction yields a negative result.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing fractions to their lowest terms or converting fractions with zero numerators into whole integers.
